websiteHomeTitle.message: SiteMark: never confuse production with test again
websiteHomeTitle.description: Browser tab title of the website home page. At most 60 characters.

websiteHomeHeading.message: Never confuse production with test again
websiteHomeHeading.description: Main heading (h1) of the website home page.

websiteHomeLead.message: SiteMark is a browser extension that marks the websites you choose with ribbons, banners and outlines, so you always know where you are.
websiteHomeLead.description: One-sentence value proposition below the home page heading.

websiteSkipToContent.description: Skip link, the first thing keyboard users reach on every page. Jumps to the main content.

websiteHeaderHome.description: Text alternative of the SiteMark wordmark in the header, which links to the home page.

websiteNavLabel.description: Accessible name of the header navigation (screen readers announce it as a navigation landmark).

websiteNavHelp.description: Navigation link to the help pages.

websiteNavPlayground.description: Navigation link to the playground, where visitors try marks in the browser.

websiteNavSupport.description: Navigation link to the support and contact page.

websiteNavPrivacy.description: Navigation link to the privacy policy.

websiteNavChangelog.description: Footer link to the changelog (the list of changes per release).

websiteLanguageLabel.description: Accessible name of the language switch (EN / NL).

websiteLanguageNameEn.description: Name of the English version in the language switch. Always written in English itself.

websiteLanguageNameNl.description: Name of the Dutch version in the language switch. Always written in Dutch itself.

websiteFooterLabel.description: Accessible name of the link list in the page footer.

websiteFooterGitHub.description: Footer link to the SiteMark repository on GitHub.

websiteFooterSitemap.description: Footer link to sitemap.xml, the list of all pages for search engines.

websiteFooterLicense.description: Footer link to the open-source license of SiteMark.

websiteFooterMadeIn.message: Made by Niels Brakel in the Netherlands.
websiteFooterMadeIn.description: Footer line that names the maker and controller (as in the privacy policy).
